name: openaccountants
title_zh: 署名会计师审过的税务指南，AI 报税不再瞎编
tagline_zh: AI 一聊到税就胡诌？这份指南由具名 CPA/EA 逐条复核，覆盖 190+ 司法辖区、1000+ 场景。
tagline_en: Stop AI tax hallucinations. 1,000+ guides vetted by named CPAs/EAs across 190+ jurisdictions. MCP server.
desc_en: Open-source Tax Guides for AI agents, reviewed by named CPAs/CAs/EAs. 1,000+ Guides across 190+ jurisdictions. MCP server included. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor.
why_zh: 不是爬虫抓的二手帖，每条都挂真人会计师名字背书。AI 引用时有据可查，错了找得到人。
why_en: Every guide carries a named accountant's review, not scraped forum noise. When AI cites a rule, a human license is behind.
limit_zh: 指南是文本参考，不替代正式税务意见；不含申报表代填或计算引擎；免费层限速，高频调用需自建。
limit_en: Text guidance only—no filing or tax computation. Free tier rate-limited; unmapped jurisdictions get explicit refusals, not guesses. Not a substitute.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: CPA-reviewed tax guides for AI agents, 190+ jurisdictions
